description.narrative: DGBP 2022. Prosperous Farmers and Forests Partnership. Vietnam.

The Prosperous Farmers and Forests Partnership (PFFP) is a community corporate partnership between WWF Finland, WWF-Viet Nam, the coffee company Slow, and WWF Denmark that aims to build sustainable, resilient, and inclusive forest economies. In the project, Slow and WWF transform monoculture coffee plantations to a regenerative agroforestry model that improves farmers’ livelihoods while protecting and improving the quality of a biodiversity corridor in Quang Tri province, between the Bac Huong Hoa and Dakrong nature reserves. The produced coffee is sold to European off-takers through long-term coffee purchase contracts that enable smallholder engagement and capacity-building in a manner which can provide high-quality, fair, and forest friendly coffee coupled with conservation outcomes, including the restoration and protection of natural forests vulnerable to climate change.
The Danida Green Business Partnerships (DGBP) programme funds and supports market-based partnership projects between commercial and non-commercial partners addressing climate and environmental challenges while contributing to inclusive growth and improved livelihoods. The programme builds on previous years’ experience with the private partnership program, DMDP.
